name: Replace stock Marlin on the six repeated decode projection shapes
hypothesis: A BF16-capable W4 kernel specialized to M=1 and the six observed N/K shapes can reduce the 96-call backbone stratum without changing the GPTQ checkpoint.
derivation: The expanded trace assigns 2.531 ms per output decision to the repeated backbone Marlin signature. The ceiling assumes at most a 30% local reduction and deliberately does not treat the calibrated memory stream as an achievable Marlin floor.

evidence.claim: Hash-bound node profile, fused shape inventory and fresh stock batch-1 baseline.
